plates.description: Default dark desktop shell with exact header, rail, navigator, workspace, inspector, bottom drawer and status geometry.
Same shell geometry in ScratchBird Light/whiteprint semantic tokens.
Top-menu order, popup/context menu rows, icon and shortcut columns, separators and danger state.
Toolbar grouping, primary/neutral/destructive buttons, focus, disabled, icon buttons and split button.
Text fields and choice controls with default/focus/error/read-only and validation behavior.
Approved-font picker with search, preview, product/generic/document-safe sections and fallback rules.
Theme and data-visualization palettes, custom hex entry, preview and reset/contrast rules.
About dialog and destructive confirmation geometry/action ordering.
Object tree row heights, indentation, guide lines, selection, badges and row actions.
Tab sizes, dirty/close behavior, splitters and docking target overlay.
Rest, dragging, valid and invalid drop targets with explicit labels and reasons.
Dense typed grid including headers, focus cell, NULL/MISSING, editing and virtualization rules.
Common designer host Toolbox and context Inspector contract.
Command palette geometry and grouped command/resource/project results.
Toast lifetimes, task drawer, progress and bottom status bar.
Preferences navigation, controls, inherited/reset model and Apply/OK behavior.
Canonical empty/loading/error/permission/disconnected/stale recovery states.
Detached windows, multi-monitor layouts and presentation/kiosk mode.
Semantic icon keys, slot sizes and registry placement rules.
Multi-step wizard rail, validation flow and action ordering.
Module-independent designer host around module-specific semantic engine.
Production/dev/read-only indicators and per-surface execution-context safety.
Approved surface hierarchy, border/emphasis styles, badges and helper/link treatment.
Secret/file/date/unit/multi-select/pagination standard controls and policies.
Separate live ResourceRef picker and project-owned AssetRef picker.
Keyboard shortcut reference surface and grid column chooser.
